comment: The four registries are each defined as "the authoritative [index / list / record / source] of/for..." with a different noun for each, and the document never states whether this variation reflects a deliberate architectural distinction (e.g. pointer-based index vs. full attribute record) or is incidental word choice.

public.text: The four registries are each defined as "the authoritative [index / list / record / source] of/for..." with a different noun for each, and the document never states whether this variation reflects a deliberate architectural distinction (e.g. pointer-based index vs. full attribute record) or is incidental word choice.
public.suggestedRevision: Either (a) standardise on one term (e.g. "authoritative source of record") across all four registries if no distinction is intended, or (b) if the distinction is deliberate, add a sentence stating so explicitly and briefly defining what "index" vs "list" vs "record" vs "source" imply for that registry's data model.
